Title: Tournament Announcement: Kill all Lifeforms, Dutch ECQ 2010!

Messages.Author: Aeschere
Messages.Body:
Hello all,

I am proud to announce the 2010 Dutch ECQ!
The event will be held on June 26 2010 at the well loved location of
De Korenbeurs in Utrecht. Further details can be found below.

Name:
Kill All Lifeforms, Dutch ECQ 2010
Location:
De Korenbeurs
Croeselaan 91
3521 BL Utrecht
The Netherlands
Registration: 10.00
First round: 11.00
Entry fee: €5

Since the location is a restaurant it is not allowed to bring your own
food or drinks.
Parking space is available and day tickets can be bought at the bar
for €6.

Please register in advance by sending me a PM, e-mail or by replying
in the relevant post on http://www.atfreeforum.com/vtesholland
Any questions you might have concerning the tournament can be asked in
the same way.

Kind Regards,

Paul Wiggers
VEKN Prince of Utrecht, The Netherlands.

Easy enough;

Phaedyme (10 blood) gets a thaumaturgy skillcard.
Phaedyme clan impersonates to Tremere (8 blood) and Freak Drives (7 blood)
Phaedyme plays Entrenching to gain 4 blood (11 blood) and Freak Drives (10
blood)
Phaedyme plays Magic of the Smith (9 blood) to get an Ankara Citadel (7
blood) and plays Freak Drive (6 blood)
Phaedyme plays Kill All Lifeforms on superior at a cost of 6 blood (0 blood)

End turn.

Next turn play Giant's Blood on Phaedyme (11 blood)
Phaedyme Plays Kill All Lifeforms on superior.

Totally working deck!
